# ONNX Runtime Inference

Uses ONNX Runtime for cross-platform model inference.

## Usage
- Loads and runs models in ONNX format on CPU, GPU, or NPU
- Supports automatic optimization with graph transformations
- Enables cross-platform deployment (Windows, Linux, macOS)
- Provides execution providers: CUDA, DirectML, OpenVINO, TensorRT
